transcript_excerpt:
John: Alright team, let's go through what we need to finish this sprint. Sarah, can you take the login bug? It's been blocking users for three days now.

Sarah: Sure, I'll fix the login timeout issue by Friday. It looks like the session handling is broken.

John: Great. Mike, we need the API documentation updated before the client meeting next week.

Mike: I'll have the API docs ready by Wednesday. Should I include the new endpoints too?

John: Yes, include everything. Also, I'll handle the database migration myself. Need to have it done by end of day tomorrow since it's blocking the new feature.

Sarah: Oh, and we should probably add some unit tests for the payment module. It's been flaky.

John: Good point. Sarah, can you add that to your list after the login fix?

Sarah: Sure, I'll write unit tests for the payment module by next Monday.

Mike: One more thing - the staging server needs a restart. It's been acting up.

John: I'll restart the staging server after this meeting. Quick 5-minute thing.

expected_tickets.description: Session handling is broken, causing users to be unable to log in. This has been blocking users for three days.

userStory.story: As a user, I want the login process to work reliably so that I can access my account without timeout errors.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user enters valid credentials, when they submit the login form, then they should be authenticated within 3 seconds
Given a session exists, when the user navigates between pages, then the session should persist correctly

expected_tickets.description: Update the API documentation to include all endpoints, including the new ones, before the client meeting next week.

userStory.story: As a developer integrating with our API, I want comprehensive and up-to-date documentation so that I can understand and use all available endpoints correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a developer accesses the API docs, when they look for any endpoint, then they should find complete request/response documentation
Given new endpoints were added, when viewing the docs, then all new endpoints should be documented with examples

expected_tickets.description: Database migration that is blocking the new feature. Needs to be done urgently.

userStory.story: As a development team, I want the database migration completed so that we can proceed with implementing the new feature.
acceptance_criteria: Given the migration runs, when completed, then all existing data should be preserved
Given the migration completes, when the new feature code runs, then it should have access to the new schema

expected_tickets.task: Write unit tests for payment module
expected_tickets.description: Add unit tests to the payment module which has been experiencing flaky behavior.

userStory.story: As a developer, I want comprehensive unit tests for the payment module so that we can catch regressions and ensure payment processing reliability.
acceptance_criteria: Given the test suite runs, when all tests pass, then code coverage should be at least 80%
Given edge cases exist, when tests run, then they should cover timeout, retry, and error scenarios

expected_tickets.description: Quick task to restart the staging server that has been acting up.
